title: `messages` property is different even on same useChat id
body:
### Description

I recently migrated my llm chat app (Tanstack Start) from v4 to v5. I noticed that the `messages` property returned by `useChat` is different on client-side route change even though they have the same `id`.

### AI SDK Version

"@ai-sdk/azure": "^2.0.0-beta.6"
"@ai-sdk/react": "^2.0.0-beta.13"
"ai": "^5.0.0-beta.13"
